<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700&family=PT+Sans:wght@400;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
body { font-family: 'PT Sans', sans-serif; }
h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; }
.page-columns .content { max-width: 95% !important; width: 95% !important; margin: 0 auto !important; }
.column-page, .column-screen, .column-body { max-width: 95% !important; margin: 0 auto !important; }
#quarto-margin-sidebar, #quarto-sidebar, .margin-sidebar { display: none !important; }
.page-columns { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; display: block !important; }
#quarto-content { padding-left: 0 !important; margin-left: 0 !important; }
main.content { margin-left: auto !important; margin-right: auto !important; padding-top: 1.5em !important; }

.mdp-container { max-width: 100%; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; }

/* Toolbar */
.mdp-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  align-items: center;
}

.mdp-btn {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg, #f8f9fa);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #333);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.mdp-btn:hover { border-color: var(--site-accent); background: var(--site-accent-soft); }
.mdp-btn.active {
  background: var(--site-accent);
  color: var(--site-accent-contrast);
  border-color: var(--site-accent);
}
.mdp-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--site-accent-ring); }

.mdp-sep {
  width: 1px;
  height: 24px;
  background: var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  margin: 0 4px;
}

.mdp-select {
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg, #f8f9fa);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #333);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.mdp-select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--site-accent); }

.mdp-mode-group { display: inline-flex; border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
.mdp-mode-group .mdp-btn { border: none; border-radius: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd); }
.mdp-mode-group .mdp-btn:last-child { border-right: none; }

.mdp-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #555);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
}
.mdp-toggle input { accent-color: var(--site-accent); cursor: pointer; }

/* Markdown-only button group */
.mdp-md-only.hidden { display: none; }

/* Outline panel */
.mdp-outline {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg, #f9f9f9);
  display: none;
  max-height: 220px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.mdp-outline.visible { display: block; }
.mdp-outline a {
  display: block;
  padding: 2px 0;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #444);
  text-decoration: none;
  border-left: 2px solid transparent;
  padding-left: 8px;
}
.mdp-outline a:hover { color: var(--site-accent); border-left-color: var(--site-accent); }
.mdp-outline .lvl-1 { font-weight: 700; margin-left: 0; }
.mdp-outline .lvl-2 { margin-left: 14px; }
.mdp-outline .lvl-3 { margin-left: 28px; }
.mdp-outline .lvl-4 { margin-left: 42px; }
.mdp-outline .lvl-5, .mdp-outline .lvl-6 { margin-left: 56px; }

/* Editor + preview */
.mdp-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  min-height: 500px;
  height: 68vh;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.mdp-pane {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 180px;
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.mdp-pane.hidden { display: none; }
#mdp-preview-pane { border-left: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd); }

.mdp-handle {
  width: 8px;
  cursor: col-resize;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg, #f0f0f0);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.15s;
  user-select: none;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.mdp-handle.hidden { display: none; }
.mdp-handle:hover, .mdp-handle.dragging { background: var(--site-accent); }
.mdp-handle::after { content: '\22EE'; color: #999; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; }
.mdp-handle:hover::after, .mdp-handle.dragging::after { color: var(--site-accent-contrast); }

.mdp-pane-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg, #f5f5f5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #555);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.mdp-pane-header .mdp-pane-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
.mdp-pane-header .mdp-pane-actions button,
.mdp-pane-header .mdp-pane-actions select {
  padding: 3px 8px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #333);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.mdp-pane-header .mdp-pane-actions button:hover {
  background: var(--site-accent);
  color: var(--site-accent-contrast);
  border-color: var(--site-accent);
}

.mdp-cm-wrap { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }
.mdp-cm-wrap .CodeMirror {
  height: 100%;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Vertical resize */
.mdp-vhandle {
  height: 8px;
  cursor: row-resize;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg, #f0f0f0);
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-top: none;
  border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.15s;
  user-select: none;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.mdp-vhandle:hover { background: var(--site-accent); }
.mdp-vhandle::after { content: '\22EF'; color: #999; font-size: 12px; }
.mdp-vhandle:hover::after { color: var(--site-accent-contrast); }

/* Preview surface */
.mdp-preview-scroll { flex: 1; overflow: auto; background: #fff; }
.mdp-preview {
  padding: 28px 34px;
  color: #1f2328;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  font-family: 'PT Sans', sans-serif;
  word-wrap: break-word;
}
.mdp-preview.width-narrow { max-width: 46em; margin: 0 auto; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-sepia { background: #fbf4e6; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-sepia .mdp-preview { color: #3a2f22; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark { background: #16181d; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview { color: #dfe3ea; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview h1,
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview h2 { border-bottom-color: #333842; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview a { color: #7ab8ff; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview blockquote { color: #a8b1bd; border-left-color: #3a4150; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview hr { border-top-color: #333842; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview h5,
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview h6 { color: #9aa3ae; }

.mdp-preview h1, .mdp-preview h2, .mdp-preview h3,
.mdp-preview h4, .mdp-preview h5, .mdp-preview h6 {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin: 1.4em 0 0.55em;
  color: inherit;
}
.mdp-preview h1 { font-size: 1.9rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e5e9; padding-bottom: 0.25em; margin-top: 0.2em; }
.mdp-preview h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e5e9; padding-bottom: 0.22em; }
.mdp-preview h3 { font-size: 1.22rem; }
.mdp-preview h4 { font-size: 1.05rem; }
.mdp-preview h5, .mdp-preview h6 { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #656d76; }
.mdp-preview p { margin: 0 0 1em; }
.mdp-preview a { color: #0969da; text-decoration: none; }
.mdp-preview a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.mdp-preview ul, .mdp-preview ol { margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 1.9em; }
.mdp-preview li { margin: 0.25em 0; }
.mdp-preview li > ul, .mdp-preview li > ol { margin-bottom: 0.2em; }
.mdp-preview blockquote {
  margin: 0 0 1em;
  padding: 0.2em 1em;
  border-left: 4px solid #d0d7de;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #656d76;
  font-size: inherit;
}
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview blockquote { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); }
.mdp-preview hr { border: none; border-top: 2px solid #e2e5e9; margin: 1.8em 0; }
.mdp-preview img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 6px; }
.mdp-preview code {
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.86em;
  color: inherit;
  background: rgba(129, 139, 152, 0.14);
  padding: 0.16em 0.36em;
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.mdp-preview pre {
  background: #f6f8fa;
  border: 1px solid #e2e5e9;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin: 0 0 1.1em;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.mdp-preview pre code {
  background: none;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  color: #24292e;
}
.mdp-preview table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 0 0 1.2em;
  display: block;
  overflow-x: auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.mdp-preview th, .mdp-preview td {
  border: 1px solid #d6dbe1;
  padding: 7px 13px;
  text-align: left;
}
.mdp-preview td { color: #1f2328; background: #fff; }
.mdp-preview th { background: #f2f4f7; color: #1f2328; font-weight: 700; }
.mdp-preview thead { background: transparent; }
.mdp-preview tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #f6f7f9; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-sepia .mdp-preview td { background: #fbf4e6; color: #3a2f22; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-sepia .mdp-preview th { background: #f2e8d3; color: #3a2f22; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-sepia .mdp-preview tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #f6eeda; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview td { background: #16181d; color: #dfe3ea; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #1c1f26; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview th { background: #232830; color: #dfe3ea; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview th,
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-preview td { border-color: #333842; }
.mdp-preview .task-list-item { list-style: none; margin-left: -1.4em; }
.mdp-preview .task-list-item input { margin-right: 0.5em; }
.mdp-preview .katex-display { overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; padding: 2px 0; }

/* Front matter card */
.mdp-frontmatter {
  border: 1px solid #d6dbe1;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--site-accent);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin: 0 0 1.4em;
  background: rgba(129, 139, 152, 0.07);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.mdp-frontmatter .fm-title { font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #656d76; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.mdp-frontmatter .fm-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 1px 0; }
.mdp-frontmatter .fm-key { font-weight: 700; min-width: 8em; }
.mdp-frontmatter .fm-val { color: #444; word-break: break-word; }
.mdp-preview-scroll.theme-dark .mdp-frontmatter .fm-val { color: #c2c8d2; }

/* Callouts */
.mdp-callout {
  border: 1px solid #d6dbe1;
  border-left: 5px solid #4a89dc;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  margin: 0 0 1.2em;
  background: rgba(74, 137, 220, 0.07);
}
.mdp-callout > :last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.mdp-callout .mdp-callout-title { font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.mdp-callout-tip { border-left-color: #2e9e5b; background: rgba(46, 158, 91, 0.08); }
.mdp-callout-warning { border-left-color: #d99a1a; background: rgba(217, 154, 26, 0.1); }
.mdp-callout-important, .mdp-callout-caution { border-left-color: #cc4b37; background: rgba(204, 75, 55, 0.08); }

/* Footnotes */
.mdp-footnotes { margin-top: 2.2em; padding-top: 1em; border-top: 1px solid #e2e5e9; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.mdp-footnotes .fn-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: #656d76; }
.mdp-footnotes ol { padding-left: 1.6em; }
.mdp-preview sup a { text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; }

/* JSON tree */
.mdp-json { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.6; }
.mdp-json .j-key { color: #8250df; font-weight: 600; }
.mdp-json .j-str { color: #0a7d43; }
.mdp-json .j-num { color: #0550ae; }
.mdp-json .j-bool { color: #cf222e; }
.mdp-json .j-null { color: #7a828e; font-style: italic; }
.mdp-json .j-punct { color: #7a828e; }
.mdp-json details > summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: revert; }
.mdp-json details { margin-left: 1.1em; }

/* Data table view */
.mdp-data-info { font-size: 0.82rem; color: #656d76; margin-bottom: 8px; }

/* Empty / error states */
.mdp-empty { color: #9aa1ab; font-style: italic; }
.mdp-error {
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff5f5;
  border: 1px solid #ffcccc;
  color: #b32020;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  display: none;
  max-height: 140px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.mdp-error.visible { display: block; }

/* Export panel */
.mdp-export {
  margin-top: 16px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 16px;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg, #f9f9f9);
  display: none;
}
.mdp-export.visible { display: block; }
.mdp-export-options { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; }
.mdp-export-btn {
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #333);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;
}
.mdp-export-btn:hover { border-color: var(--site-accent); background: var(--site-accent-soft); }

/* Status bar */
.mdp-status {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg, #f5f5f5);
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: #666;
}
.mdp-status .s-left, .mdp-status .s-right { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.mdp-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4caf50; display: inline-block; margin-right: 4px; }
.mdp-dot.error { background: #f44336; }
#mdp-detected { color: var(--site-accent); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }

/* Drop overlay */
.mdp-drop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 3px dashed var(--site-accent);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--site-accent-soft);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--site-accent);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.mdp-drop.visible { display: flex; }

/* Fullscreen */
.mdp-fullscreen {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: #fff;
  z-index: 9999;
  overflow: auto;
}
.mdp-fullscreen.active { display: block; }
.mdp-fullscreen-close {
  position: fixed;
  top: 16px;
  right: 16px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1.5px solid #ddd;
  background: #f5f5f5;
  color: #333;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: 10000;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .mdp-wrapper { flex-direction: column; height: auto; }
  .mdp-handle { display: none; }
  .mdp-pane { min-height: 320px; }
  #mdp-preview-pane { border-left: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd); }
}

@media print {
  .mdp-toolbar, .mdp-outline, .mdp-status, .mdp-export, .mdp-vhandle, .mdp-handle, #mdp-editor-pane { display: none !important; }
  .mdp-wrapper { border: none; height: auto; }
  .mdp-pane-header { display: none; }
}
</style>

<p>A Markdown editor and viewer with live preview. It reads Markdown and GitHub flavored Markdown, Quarto and R Markdown, HTML, JSON, and CSV or TSV data. Math, Mermaid diagrams, syntax highlighted code, footnotes, and callouts all render as you type. Open a file by dragging it onto the page. Everything runs locally in your browser, and nothing is uploaded.</p>

<div class="mdp-container" id="mdp-container">

<div class="mdp-drop" id="mdp-drop">Drop a file to open it</div>

<!-- Toolbar -->
<div class="mdp-toolbar">
  <select class="mdp-select" id="mdp-format" title="Input format">
    <option value="markdown">Markdown / GFM</option>
    <option value="quarto">Quarto / R Markdown</option>
    <option value="html">HTML</option>
    <option value="json">JSON</option>
    <option value="csv">CSV / TSV</option>
    <option value="text">Plain Text</option>
  </select>
  <button class="mdp-btn" data-act="open">&#128193; Open File</button>
  <button class="mdp-btn" data-act="outline" id="mdp-btn-outline">&#128209; Outline</button>
  <input type="file" id="mdp-file" accept=".md,.markdown,.mdown,.mkd,.qmd,.rmd,.Rmd,.txt,.text,.html,.htm,.json,.csv,.tsv,.log" style="display:none">
  <span class="mdp-sep"></span>
  <span class="mdp-md-only" id="mdp-md-tools">
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-ins="**|**" title="Bold (Ctrl+B)"><b>B</b></button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-ins="*|*" title="Italic (Ctrl+I)"><i>I</i></button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-ins="~~|~~" title="Strikethrough"><s>S</s></button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-ins="`|`" title="Inline code">&lt;/&gt;</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-ins="[|](https://)" title="Link (Ctrl+K)">&#128279;</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-ins="![|](https://)" title="Image">&#128444;</button>
    <span class="mdp-sep"></span>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-line="## " title="Heading">H2</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-line="- " title="Bullet list">&#8226; List</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-line="1. " title="Numbered list">1. List</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-line="- [ ] " title="Task list">&#9744; Task</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-line="&gt; " title="Blockquote">&#8220;&#8221;</button>
    <span class="mdp-sep"></span>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-act="table" title="Insert table">Table</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-act="codeblock" title="Insert fenced code block">Code</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-ins="$$\n|\n$$" title="Display math">&#8721; Math</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-act="hr" title="Horizontal rule">&#8213;</button>
  </span>
  <span class="mdp-sep"></span>
  <span class="mdp-mode-group">
    <button class="mdp-btn active" data-view="split">Split</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-view="editor">Editor</button>
    <button class="mdp-btn" data-view="preview">Preview</button>
  </span>
  <label class="mdp-toggle" title="Scroll both panes together"><input type="checkbox" id="mdp-sync" checked> Sync scroll</label>
  <span class="mdp-sep"></span>
  <button class="mdp-btn" data-act="export" id="mdp-btn-export">&#128228; Export</button>
  <button class="mdp-btn" data-act="fullscreen">&#9974; Fullscreen</button>
</div>

<!-- Outline -->
<div class="mdp-outline" id="mdp-outline"></div>

<!-- Panes -->
<div class="mdp-wrapper" id="mdp-wrapper">
  <div class="mdp-pane" id="mdp-editor-pane">
    <div class="mdp-pane-header">
      <span>&#128221; Source</span>
      <div class="mdp-pane-actions">
        <button data-act="sample">Sample</button>
        <button data-act="format-src">Tidy</button>
        <button data-act="copy-src">Copy</button>
        <button data-act="clear">Clear</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mdp-cm-wrap" id="mdp-cm-wrap"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="mdp-handle" id="mdp-handle"></div>
  <div class="mdp-pane" id="mdp-preview-pane">
    <div class="mdp-pane-header">
      <span>&#128065; Preview</span>
      <div class="mdp-pane-actions">
        <select id="mdp-theme" title="Preview theme">
          <option value="light">Light</option>
          <option value="sepia">Sepia</option>
          <option value="dark">Dark</option>
        </select>
        <select id="mdp-width" title="Preview width">
          <option value="narrow">Narrow</option>
          <option value="full">Full</option>
        </select>
        <button data-act="copy-html">Copy HTML</button>
        <button data-act="copy-rich">Copy Rich</button>
        <button data-act="print">Print</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="mdp-preview-scroll" id="mdp-preview-scroll">
      <div class="mdp-preview width-narrow" id="mdp-preview"><span class="mdp-empty">Live preview will appear here.</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="mdp-vhandle" id="mdp-vhandle"></div>

<div class="mdp-error" id="mdp-error"></div>

<div class="mdp-export" id="mdp-export">
  <strong>Export Options</strong>
  <div class="mdp-export-options">
    <button class="mdp-export-btn" data-act="exp-source">&#128190; Source File</button>
    <button class="mdp-export-btn" data-act="exp-html">&#127760; Standalone HTML</button>
    <button class="mdp-export-btn" data-act="exp-pdf">&#128195; PDF (print)</button>
    <button class="mdp-export-btn" data-act="exp-png">&#128444; PNG Image</button>
    <button class="mdp-export-btn" data-act="exp-txt">&#128196; Plain Text</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="mdp-status">
  <div class="s-left">
    <span><span class="mdp-dot" id="mdp-dot"></span><span id="mdp-status-text">Ready</span></span>
    <span id="mdp-words">0 words</span>
    <span id="mdp-chars">0 chars</span>
    <span id="mdp-lines">1 line</span>
    <span id="mdp-read">0 min read</span>
    <span id="mdp-detected"></span>
  </div>
  <div class="s-right">
    <span id="mdp-cursor">Ln 1, Col 1</span>
    <span>marked + KaTeX + CodeMirror</span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="mdp-fullscreen" id="mdp-fullscreen">
  <button class="mdp-fullscreen-close" data-act="fullscreen">&#10005; Close</button>
  <div class="mdp-preview-scroll" style="background:transparent;">
    <div class="mdp-preview width-narrow" id="mdp-fullscreen-body" style="padding:48px 32px;"></div>
  </div>
</div>

</div>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/lib/codemirror.min.css">

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.9.0/styles/github.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/lib/codemirror.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/addon/mode/overlay.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/meta.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/xml/xml.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/markdown/markdown.min.js"></script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/python/python.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/css/css.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/htmlmixed/htmlmixed.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/yaml/yaml.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/shell/shell.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/r/r.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/mode/stex/stex.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/addon/edit/matchbrackets.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/addon/edit/closebrackets.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.16/addon/selection/active-line.min.js"></script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.1.6/dist/purify.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.9.0/highlight.min.js"></script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var BT = String.fromCharCode(96);
  var FENCE = BT + BT + BT;
  var STORE_KEY = 'mdp-content';
  var STORE_FMT = 'mdp-format';

  var el = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var cm = null;
  var format = 'markdown';
  var viewMode = 'split';
  var fileName = 'document.md';
  var debounce = null;
  var mathStore = [];
  var syncing = false;

  var preview = el('mdp-preview');
  var previewScroll = el('mdp-preview-scroll');
  var errorBox = el('mdp-error');
  var dot = el('mdp-dot');
  var statusText = el('mdp-status-text');

  var EXT_BY_FORMAT = { markdown: 'md', quarto: 'qmd', html: 'html', json: 'json', csv: 'csv', text: 'txt' };
  var LABELS = { markdown: 'Markdown', quarto: 'Quarto', html: 'HTML', json: 'JSON', csv: 'CSV', text: 'Plain text' };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- sample
  var SAMPLE = [
    '---',
    'title: "Markdown Preview"',
    'author: "You"',
    'date: "2026-08-04"',
    '---',
    '',
    '# Markdown Preview',
    '',
    'Type on the left, read on the right. Everything below is ordinary Markdown.',
    '',
    '## Text formatting',
    '',
    'You can write **bold**, *italic*, ~~struck out~~, and ' + BT + 'inline code' + BT + '.',
    'Links look like [this one](https://daringfireball.net/projects/markdown/).',
    'Footnotes work too.[^note]',
    '',
    '[^note]: A footnote lands at the bottom of the document.',
    '',
    '## Lists',
    '',
    '- Bullet item',
    '  - Nested item',
    '- [x] Finished task',
    '- [ ] Pending task',
    '',
    '1. First step',
    '2. Second step',
    '',
    '## Table',
    '',
    '| Format | Extension | Notes |',
    '|--------|-----------|-------|',
    '| Markdown | .md | GitHub flavored |',
    '| Quarto | .qmd | Front matter and callouts |',
    '| Data | .csv | Rendered as a table |',
    '',
    '## Math',
    '',
    'Inline math such as $e^{i\\pi} + 1 = 0$ sits in the sentence, and display math stands alone.',
    '',
    '$$',
    '\\int_{-\\infty}^{\\infty} e^{-x^2}\\,dx = \\sqrt{\\pi}',
    '$$',
    '',
    '## Code',
    '',
    FENCE + 'python',
    'def greet(name):',
    '    return f"Hello, {name}"',
    FENCE,
    '',
    '## Diagram',
    '',
    FENCE + 'mermaid',
    'graph LR',
    '  A[Write] --> B[Preview]',
    '  B --> C[Export]',
    FENCE,
    '',
    '## Callout',
    '',
    '::: {.callout-tip}',
    'Drag a file onto this page to open it, or press the Open File button.',
    ':::',
    '',
    '> A blockquote closes the tour.'
  ].join('\n');

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ detection
  function detectFormat(text, name) {
    if (name) {
      var ext = (name.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase();
      if (ext === 'qmd' || ext === 'rmd') return 'quarto';
      if (ext === 'md' || ext === 'markdown' || ext === 'mdown' || ext === 'mkd') return 'markdown';
      if (ext === 'html' || ext === 'htm') return 'html';
      if (ext === 'json') return 'json';
      if (ext === 'csv' || ext === 'tsv') return 'csv';
      if (ext === 'txt' || ext === 'text' || ext === 'log') return 'text';
    }
    var t = (text || '').trim();
    if (!t) return 'markdown';
    var head = t.substring(0, 3000);
    if (/^\s*[[{][\s\S]*[\]}]\s*$/.test(t)) {
      try { JSON.parse(t); return 'json'; } catch (e) { /* not JSON */ }
    }
    if (/^<!DOCTYPE html|^<html|^<\?xml/i.test(head)) return 'html';
    if (/```\{[a-z]/i.test(head) || /^---[\s\S]*?\nformat:/m.test(head) || /\n:::\s*\{\.callout/.test(head)) return 'quarto';
    if (/^#{1,6}\s|\n#{1,6}\s|^\s*[-*+]\s|\n\s*[-*+]\s|\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)|^```/m.test(head)) return 'markdown';
    if (/<\/(div|p|span|body|table|section)>/i.test(head)) return 'html';
    var lines = head.split('\n').filter(function (l) { return l.trim(); }).slice(0, 6);
    if (lines.length > 1) {
      var counts = lines.map(function (l) { return (l.match(/[,\t;]/g) || []).length; });
      if (counts[0] > 0 && counts.every(function (c) { return c === counts[0]; })) return 'csv';
    }
    return 'text';
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------- source helpers
  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  // Split into fenced-code and prose segments so transforms skip code.
  function segments(src) {
    var lines = src.split('\n');
    var out = [];
    var buf = [];
    var inFence = false;
    var mark = '';
    var len = 0;
    function flush(isCode) {
      if (buf.length) { out.push({ code: isCode, text: buf.join('\n') }); buf = []; }
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      var line = lines[i];
      if (!inFence) {
        var open = line.match(/^\s{0,3}([`~]{3,})(.*)$/);
        if (open) {
          flush(false);
          inFence = true;
          mark = open[1].charAt(0);
          len = open[1].length;
          buf.push(line);
          continue;
        }
        buf.push(line);
      } else {
        buf.push(line);
        var close = line.match(/^\s{0,3}([`~]{3,})\s*$/);
        if (close && close[1].charAt(0) === mark && close[1].length >= len) {
          flush(true);
          inFence = false;
        }
      }
    }
    flush(inFence);
    return out;
  }

  function mapProse(src, fn) {
    return segments(src).map(function (seg) {
      return seg.code ? seg.text : fn(seg.text);
    }).join('\n');
  }

  function splitFrontMatter(src) {
    var m = src.match(/^---[ \t]*\n([\s\S]*?)\n---[ \t]*(?:\n|$)/);
    if (!m) return { meta: null, body: src };
    return { meta: m[1], body: src.slice(m[0].length) };
  }

  function frontMatterHtml(yaml) {
    var rows = '';
    yaml.split('\n').forEach(function (line) {
      if (!line.trim() || /^\s*#/.test(line)) return;
      var m = line.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\s*:\s*(.*)$/);
      if (m) {
        var val = m[2].replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        rows += '<div class="fm-row"><span class="fm-key">' + escapeHtml(m[1]) +
          '</span><span class="fm-val">' + escapeHtml(val) + '</span></div>';
      } else if (/^\s+/.test(line)) {
        rows += '<div class="fm-row"><span class="fm-key"></span><span class="fm-val">' +
          escapeHtml(line.trim()) + '</span></div>';
      }
    });
    if (!rows) return '';
    return '<div class="mdp-frontmatter"><div class="fm-title">Front matter</div>' + rows + '</div>';
  }

  // Quarto executable fences: ```{python} becomes ```python
  function normalizeFences(src) {
    return src.replace(/^(\s{0,3}[`~]{3,})\{([A-Za-z][\w-]*)[^}]*\}\s*$/gm, '$1$2');
  }

  // Quarto/Pandoc fenced divs for callouts
  function convertCallouts(src) {
    var lines = src.split('\n');
    var out = [];
    var stack = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      var line = lines[i];
      var open = line.match(/^:::+\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*$/);
      if (open) {
        var attrs = open[1];
        var kind = (attrs.match(/\.callout-([a-z]+)/) || [])[1];
        var title = (attrs.match(/title\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"/) || [])[1];
        if (kind) {
          out.push('<div class="mdp-callout mdp-callout-' + kind + '">');
          out.push('<div class="mdp-callout-title">' + escapeHtml(title || (kind.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + kind.slice(1))) + '</div>');
        } else {
          out.push('<div class="mdp-fenced-div">');
        }
        out.push('');
        stack.push(true);
        continue;
      }
      if (/^:::+\s*$/.test(line) && stack.length) {
        stack.pop();
        out.push('');
        out.push('</div>');
        continue;
      }
      out.push(line);
    }
    while (stack.length) { stack.pop(); out.push('</div>'); }
    return out.join('\n');
  }

  // Pull math out before Markdown parsing, restore rendered KaTeX afterwards.
  function stashMath(src) {
    mathStore = [];
    function token(tex, display) {
      mathStore.push({ tex: tex, display: display });
      return 'xxMATHxx' + (mathStore.length - 1) + 'xxENDxx';
    }
    return mapProse(src, function (chunk) {
      chunk = chunk.replace(/\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$/g, function (_, tex) { return token(tex, true); });
      chunk = chunk.replace(/\\\[([\s\S]+?)\\\]/g, function (_, tex) { return token(tex, true); });
      chunk = chunk.replace(/\\\(([\s\S]+?)\\\)/g, function (_, tex) { return token(tex, false); });
      chunk = chunk.replace(/(`+)([\s\S]*?)\1|\$([^\s$][^$\n]*?)\$/g, function (whole, ticks, _code, tex) {
        if (ticks) return whole;
        if (/\s$/.test(tex)) return whole;
        return token(tex, false);
      });
      return chunk;
    });
  }

  function restoreMath(html) {
    return html.replace(/xxMATHxx(\d+)xxENDxx/g, function (whole, idx) {
      var item = mathStore[Number(idx)];
      if (!item) return whole;
      if (typeof katex === 'undefined') return escapeHtml(item.tex);
      try {
        return katex.renderToString(item.tex, { displayMode: item.display, throwOnError: false, output: 'html' });
      } catch (e) {
        return '<code>' + escapeHtml(item.tex) + '</code>';
      }
    });
  }

  // Footnotes ([^id] references plus [^id]: definitions)
  function extractFootnotes(src) {
    var defs = [];
    var order = {};
    var body = mapProse(src, function (chunk) {
      var lines = chunk.split('\n');
      var kept = [];
      var current = null;
      for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        var m = lines[i].match(/^\[\^([^\]]+)\]:\s*(.*)$/);
        if (m) {
          current = { id: m[1], text: m[2] };
          defs.push(current);
          continue;
        }
        if (current && /^\s{2,}\S/.test(lines[i])) {
          current.text += '\n' + lines[i].trim();
          continue;
        }
        current = null;
        kept.push(lines[i]);
      }
      return kept.join('\n');
    });
    if (!defs.length) return { body: src, notes: '' };
    defs.forEach(function (d, i) { order[d.id] = i + 1; });
    body = mapProse(body, function (chunk) {
      return chunk.replace(/\[\^([^\]]+)\]/g, function (whole, id) {
        if (!order[id]) return whole;
        var n = order[id];
        return '<sup id="fnref-' + n + '"><a href="#fn-' + n + '">' + n + '</a></sup>';
      });
    });
    var items = defs.map(function (d, i) {
      var inner = marked.parse(d.text);
      return '<li id="fn-' + (i + 1) + '">' + inner +
        '<a href="#fnref-' + (i + 1) + '" title="Back to text">&#8617;</a></li>';
    }).join('');
    return { body: body, notes: '<div class="mdp-footnotes"><div class="fn-label">Footnotes</div><ol>' + items + '</ol></div>' };
  }

  function sanitize(html) {
    if (typeof DOMPurify === 'undefined') return html;
    return DOMPurify.sanitize(html, {
      USE_PROFILES: { html: true, svg: true, svgFilters: true, mathMl: true },
      ADD_ATTR: ['target', 'align', 'colspan', 'rowspan', 'start', 'checked', 'disabled', 'aria-hidden', 'id']
    });
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- renders
  function renderMarkdown(src) {
    var fm = splitFrontMatter(src);
    var body = fm.body;
    body = normalizeFences(body);
    body = convertCallouts(body);
    var fn = extractFootnotes(body);
    body = stashMath(fn.body);
    var html = marked.parse(body, { gfm: true, breaks: false });
    html = restoreMath(html) + fn.notes;
    html = sanitize(html);
    if (fm.meta) html = frontMatterHtml(fm.meta) + html;
    return html;
  }

  function renderHtmlSource(src) {
    return sanitize(src);
  }

  function renderText(src) {
    return '<pre><code>' + escapeHtml(src) + '</code></pre>';
  }

  function jsonNode(value, key) {
    var keyHtml = key === undefined ? '' : '<span class="j-key">"' + escapeHtml(key) + '"</span><span class="j-punct">: </span>';
    if (value === null) return '<div>' + keyHtml + '<span class="j-null">null</span></div>';
    var type = typeof value;
    if (type === 'string') return '<div>' + keyHtml + '<span class="j-str">"' + escapeHtml(value) + '"</span></div>';
    if (type === 'number') return '<div>' + keyHtml + '<span class="j-num">' + value + '</span></div>';
    if (type === 'boolean') return '<div>' + keyHtml + '<span class="j-bool">' + value + '</span></div>';
    var isArray = Array.isArray(value);
    var keys = isArray ? value.map(function (_, i) { return i; }) : Object.keys(value);
    var open = isArray ? '[' : '{';
    var close = isArray ? ']' : '}';
    if (!keys.length) return '<div>' + keyHtml + '<span class="j-punct">' + open + close + '</span></div>';
    var kids = keys.map(function (k) {
      return jsonNode(value[k], isArray ? undefined : String(k));
    }).join('');
    return '<details open><summary>' + keyHtml + '<span class="j-punct">' + open + '</span> ' +
      '<span class="j-null">' + keys.length + ' item' + (keys.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</span>' +
      '</summary>' + kids + '<div><span class="j-punct">' + close + '</span></div></details>';
  }

  function renderJson(src) {
    var data;
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(src);
    } catch (e) {
      showError('JSON parse error: ' + e.message);
      return '<pre><code>' + escapeHtml(src) + '</code></pre>';
    }
    return '<div class="mdp-json">' + jsonNode(data) + '</div>';
  }

  function parseDelimited(src, delim) {
    var rows = [];
    var row = [];
    var field = '';
    var quoted = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
      var ch = src.charAt(i);
      if (quoted) {
        if (ch === '"') {
          if (src.charAt(i + 1) === '"') { field += '"'; i++; }
          else quoted = false;
        } else field += ch;
        continue;
      }
      if (ch === '"') { quoted = true; continue; }
      if (ch === delim) { row.push(field); field = ''; continue; }
      if (ch === '\n') { row.push(field); rows.push(row); row = []; field = ''; continue; }
      if (ch === '\r') continue;
      field += ch;
    }
    if (field !== '' || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row); }
    return rows.filter(function (r) { return r.length > 1 || (r[0] || '').trim() !== ''; });
  }

  // Built with DOM APIs on purpose: literal table markup inside a script
  // string is rewritten by the Quarto HTML postprocessor.
  function renderDelimited(src, target) {
    var first = src.split('\n')[0] || '';
    var delim = ',';
    if ((first.match(/\t/g) || []).length > (first.match(/,/g) || []).length) delim = '\t';
    else if ((first.match(/;/g) || []).length > (first.match(/,/g) || []).length) delim = ';';
    var rows = parseDelimited(src, delim);
    target.innerHTML = '';
    if (!rows.length) {
      target.innerHTML = '<span class="mdp-empty">No rows found.</span>';
      return;
    }
    var info = document.createElement('div');
    info.className = 'mdp-data-info';
    info.textContent = rows.length - 1 + ' data rows, ' + rows[0].length + ' columns, delimiter ' +
      (delim === '\t' ? 'tab' : delim);
    target.appendChild(info);
    var table = document.createElement('table');
    var thead = document.createElement('thead');
    var hrow = document.createElement('tr');
    rows[0].forEach(function (cell) {
      var th = document.createElement('th');
      th.textContent = cell;
      hrow.appendChild(th);
    });
    thead.appendChild(hrow);
    table.appendChild(thead);
    var tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
    for (var r = 1; r < rows.length; r++) {
      var tr = document.createElement('tr');
      for (var c = 0; c < rows[0].length; c++) {
        var td = document.createElement('td');
        td.textContent = rows[r][c] === undefined ? '' : rows[r][c];
        tr.appendChild(td);
      }
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    }
    table.appendChild(tbody);
    target.appendChild(table);
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- postfix
  function slugify(text, used) {
    var base = text.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '-') || 'section';
    var slug = base;
    var n = 2;
    while (used[slug]) { slug = base + '-' + n; n++; }
    used[slug] = true;
    return slug;
  }

  function buildOutline() {
    var box = el('mdp-outline');
    var heads = preview.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6');
    box.innerHTML = '';
    if (!heads.length) {
      box.innerHTML = '<span class="mdp-empty">No headings in this document.</span>';
      return;
    }
    heads.forEach(function (h) {
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.className = 'lvl-' + h.tagName.charAt(1);
      a.textContent = h.textContent;
      a.href = '#';
      a.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        previewScroll.scrollTo({ top: h.offsetTop - 12, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
      box.appendChild(a);
    });
  }

  function highlightCode() {
    if (typeof hljs === 'undefined') return;
    preview.querySelectorAll('pre code').forEach(function (block) {
      if (block.classList.contains('language-mermaid')) return;
      try { hljs.highlightElement(block); } catch (e) { /* leave as plain text */ }
    });
  }

  function runMermaid() {
    var blocks = preview.querySelectorAll('code.language-mermaid');
    if (!blocks.length) return;
    var nodes = [];
    blocks.forEach(function (block, i) {
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'mermaid';
      div.id = 'mdp-mermaid-' + Date.now() + '-' + i;
      div.textContent = block.textContent;
      var pre = block.parentElement;
      pre.parentElement.replaceChild(div, pre);
      nodes.push(div);
    });
    function go() {
      try {
        mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, securityLevel: 'strict', theme: 'default' });
        mermaid.run({ nodes: nodes });
      } catch (e) {
        showError('Mermaid error: ' + e.message);
      }
    }
    if (typeof mermaid === 'undefined') {
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@10.9.1/dist/mermaid.min.js';
      s.onload = go;
      s.onerror = function () { showError('Could not load the Mermaid library.'); };
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    } else go();
  }

  function decorate() {
    var used = {};
    preview.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6').forEach(function (h) {
      if (!h.id) h.id = slugify(h.textContent, used);
    });
    preview.querySelectorAll('a[href^="http"]').forEach(function (a) {
      a.target = '_blank';
      a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    });
    preview.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(function (li) {
      if (li.querySelector(':scope > input[type="checkbox"]')) li.classList.add('task-list-item');
    });
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- errors
  function showError(msg) {
    errorBox.textContent = msg;
    errorBox.classList.add('visible');
    dot.className = 'mdp-dot error';
    statusText.textContent = 'Warning';
  }

  function clearError() {
    errorBox.textContent = '';
    errorBox.classList.remove('visible');
    dot.className = 'mdp-dot';
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- render
  function render() {
    var src = cm ? cm.getValue() : '';
    clearError();
    if (!src.trim()) {
      preview.innerHTML = '<span class="mdp-empty">Live preview will appear here.</span>';
      statusText.textContent = 'Ready';
      el('mdp-outline').innerHTML = '<span class="mdp-empty">No headings in this document.</span>';
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (format === 'csv') {
        renderDelimited(src, preview);
      } else if (format === 'json') {
        preview.innerHTML = renderJson(src);
      } else if (format === 'html') {
        preview.innerHTML = renderHtmlSource(src);
      } else if (format === 'text') {
        preview.innerHTML = renderText(src);
      } else {
        preview.innerHTML = renderMarkdown(src);
      }
      decorate();
      highlightCode();
      runMermaid();
      buildOutline();
      if (!errorBox.classList.contains('visible')) statusText.textContent = 'Rendered';
    } catch (e) {
      showError('Render error: ' + e.message);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- status
  function updateStatus() {
    var text = cm.getValue();
    var words = text.trim() ? text.trim().split(/\s+/).length : 0;
    el('mdp-chars').textContent = text.length + ' chars';
    el('mdp-words').textContent = words + ' words';
    el('mdp-lines').textContent = cm.lineCount() + (cm.lineCount() === 1 ? ' line' : ' lines');
    el('mdp-read').textContent = Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 200)) + ' min read';
  }

  function save() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, cm.getValue());
      localStorage.setItem(STORE_FMT, format);
    } catch (e) { /* storage may be full or blocked */ }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- formats
  function cmMode(fmt) {
    if (fmt === 'html') return 'htmlmixed';
    if (fmt === 'json') return { name: 'javascript', json: true };
    if (fmt === 'csv' || fmt === 'text') return 'text/plain';
    return 'gfm';
  }

  function setFormat(fmt, quiet) {
    format = fmt;
    el('mdp-format').value = fmt;
    if (cm) cm.setOption('mode', cmMode(fmt));
    el('mdp-md-tools').classList.toggle('hidden', fmt !== 'markdown' && fmt !== 'quarto');
    if (!quiet) {
      el('mdp-detected').textContent = '';
      render();
      save();
    }
  }

  function checkDetection() {
    var guess = detectFormat(cm.getValue(), null);
    var hint = el('mdp-detected');
    if (guess !== format && (guess !== 'markdown' || format !== 'quarto') && (guess !== 'quarto' || format !== 'markdown')) {
      hint.textContent = 'Looks like ' + LABELS[guess] + '. Click to switch.';
      hint.onclick = function () { setFormat(guess); };
    } else {
      hint.textContent = '';
      hint.onclick = null;
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------- editing
  function insertAround(pattern) {
    var parts = pattern.split('|');
    var before = parts[0].replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    var after = (parts[1] || '').replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    var sel = cm.getSelection();
    var cursor = cm.getCursor('from');
    cm.replaceSelection(before + sel + after);
    if (!sel) {
      var lines = before.split('\n');
      cm.setCursor({
        line: cursor.line + lines.length - 1,
        ch: lines.length > 1 ? lines[lines.length - 1].length : cursor.ch + before.length
      });
    }
    cm.focus();
    render();
  }

  function prefixLines(prefix) {
    var from = cm.getCursor('from');
    var to = cm.getCursor('to');
    for (var i = from.line; i <= to.line; i++) {
      var line = cm.getLine(i);
      cm.replaceRange(prefix + line, { line: i, ch: 0 }, { line: i, ch: line.length });
    }
    cm.focus();
    render();
  }

  function insertBlock(text) {
    var cursor = cm.getCursor();
    var prefix = cursor.ch === 0 ? '' : '\n';
    cm.replaceSelection(prefix + text + '\n');
    cm.focus();
    render();
  }

  function tidySource() {
    if (format === 'json') {
      try {
        cm.setValue(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(cm.getValue()), null, 2));
      } catch (e) {
        showError('Cannot tidy invalid JSON: ' + e.message);
        return;
      }
    } else {
      var text = cm.getValue()
        .replace(/[ \t]+$/gm, '')
        .replace(/\n{4,}/g, '\n\n\n');
      cm.setValue(text.replace(/\s+$/, '') + '\n');
    }
    render();
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- exports
  function download(content, name, type) {
    var blob = new Blob([content], { type: type });
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = name;
    a.click();
    setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 1000);
    flash('Downloaded ' + name);
  }

  function flash(msg) {
    statusText.textContent = msg;
    setTimeout(function () { statusText.textContent = 'Rendered'; }, 2200);
  }

  function baseName() {
    return fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') || 'document';
  }

  function standaloneHtml() {
    var css = [
      'body{font-family:Georgia,serif;max-width:46em;margin:40px auto;padding:0 20px;line-height:1.7;color:#1f2328;}',
      'h1,h2{border-bottom:1px solid #e2e5e9;padding-bottom:.25em;}',
      'code{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;background:rgba(129,139,152,.14);padding:.16em .36em;border-radius:5px;}',
      'pre{background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #e2e5e9;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;overflow-x:auto;}',
      'pre code{background:none;padding:0;}',
      'table{border-collapse:collapse;}th,td{border:1px solid #d6dbe1;padding:7px 13px;text-align:left;}',
      'th{background:#f2f4f7;}blockquote{border-left:4px solid #d0d7de;color:#656d76;margin:0 0 1em;padding:.2em 1em;}',
      'img{max-width:100%;}'
    ].join('\n');
    return '<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang="en">\n<head>\n<meta charset="utf-8">\n' +
      '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">\n' +
      '<title>' + escapeHtml(baseName()) + '</title>\n' +
      '<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.css">\n' +
      '<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.9.0/styles/github.min.css">\n' +
      '<style>\n' + css + '\n<\/style>\n</head>\n<body>\n' + preview.innerHTML + '\n</body>\n</html>';
  }

  function printPreview() {
    var win = window.open('', '_blank');
    if (!win) { showError('The browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-ups for this page.'); return; }
    win.document.open();
    win.document.write(standaloneHtml());
    win.document.close();
    win.focus();
    setTimeout(function () { win.print(); }, 400);
  }

  function exportPng() {
    function shoot() {
      html2canvas(preview, { backgroundColor: '#ffffff', scale: 2, useCORS: true }).then(function (canvas) {
        canvas.toBlob(function (blob) {
          var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          var a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = url;
          a.download = baseName() + '.png';
          a.click();
          setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 1000);
          flash('Downloaded ' + baseName() + '.png');
        });
      });
    }
    if (typeof html2canvas === 'undefined') {
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html2canvas@1.4.1/dist/html2canvas.min.js';
      s.onload = shoot;
      s.onerror = function () { showError('Could not load the image library.'); };
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    } else shoot();
  }

  function copyRich() {
    var html = preview.innerHTML;
    var text = preview.innerText;
    if (window.ClipboardItem && navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.write) {
      var item = new ClipboardItem({
        'text/html': new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }),
        'text/plain': new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' })
      });
      navigator.clipboard.write([item]).then(function () {
        flash('Formatted text copied');
      }).catch(function () { showError('The browser blocked the clipboard write.'); });
    } else {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { flash('Plain text copied'); });
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ file open
  function loadFile(file) {
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function () {
      fileName = file.name;
      var text = String(reader.result);
      setFormat(detectFormat(text, file.name), true);
      cm.setValue(text);
      cm.setCursor({ line: 0, ch: 0 });
      render();
      updateStatus();
      save();
      flash('Opened ' + file.name);
    };
    reader.onerror = function () { showError('Could not read that file.'); };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------- view modes
  function setView(mode) {
    viewMode = mode;
    el('mdp-editor-pane').classList.toggle('hidden', mode === 'preview');
    el('mdp-preview-pane').classList.toggle('hidden', mode === 'editor');
    el('mdp-handle').classList.toggle('hidden', mode !== 'split');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-view') === mode);
    });
    if (mode !== 'split') {
      el('mdp-editor-pane').style.width = '';
      el('mdp-preview-pane').style.width = '';
      el('mdp-editor-pane').style.flex = '1';
      el('mdp-preview-pane').style.flex = '1';
    }
    if (cm) setTimeout(function () { cm.refresh(); }, 30);
  }

  function toggleFullscreen() {
    var fs = el('mdp-fullscreen');
    fs.classList.toggle('active');
    if (fs.classList.contains('active')) {
      el('mdp-fullscreen-body').innerHTML = preview.innerHTML;
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- actions
  var actions = {
    open: function () { el('mdp-file').click(); },
    outline: function () {
      el('mdp-outline').classList.toggle('visible');
      el('mdp-btn-outline').classList.toggle('active');
    },
    export: function () {
      el('mdp-export').classList.toggle('visible');
      el('mdp-btn-export').classList.toggle('active');
    },
    fullscreen: toggleFullscreen,
    sample: function () {
      setFormat('markdown', true);
      fileName = 'sample.md';
      cm.setValue(SAMPLE);
      render();
      updateStatus();
    },
    clear: function () {
      if (cm.getValue() && !confirm('Clear the editor?')) return;
      cm.setValue('');
      render();
      updateStatus();
      save();
    },
    'copy-src': function () {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(cm.getValue()).then(function () { flash('Source copied'); });
    },
    'copy-html': function () {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(preview.innerHTML).then(function () { flash('HTML copied'); });
    },
    'copy-rich': copyRich,
    'format-src': tidySource,
    print: printPreview,
    table: function () {
      insertBlock('| Column A | Column B |\n|----------|----------|\n| Value 1  | Value 2  |');
    },
    codeblock: function () { insertBlock(FENCE + 'python\n\n' + FENCE); },
    hr: function () { insertBlock('---'); },
    'exp-source': function () {
      download(cm.getValue(), baseName() + '.' + EXT_BY_FORMAT[format], 'text/plain;charset=utf-8');
    },
    'exp-html': function () {
      download(standaloneHtml(), baseName() + '.html', 'text/html;charset=utf-8');
    },
    'exp-pdf': printPreview,
    'exp-png': exportPng,
    'exp-txt': function () {
      download(preview.innerText, baseName() + '.txt', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8');
    }
  };

  document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    var target = ev.target.closest('[data-act], [data-ins], [data-line], [data-view]');
    if (!target || !el('mdp-container').contains(target)) return;
    var act = target.getAttribute('data-act');
    var ins = target.getAttribute('data-ins');
    var line = target.getAttribute('data-line');
    var view = target.getAttribute('data-view');
    if (act && actions[act]) { ev.preventDefault(); actions[act](); }
    else if (ins) { ev.preventDefault(); insertAround(ins); }
    else if (line) { ev.preventDefault(); prefixLines(line); }
    else if (view) { ev.preventDefault(); setView(view); }
  });

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- resize
  function initResize() {
    var handle = el('mdp-handle');
    var wrapper = el('mdp-wrapper');
    var left = el('mdp-editor-pane');
    var right = el('mdp-preview-pane');

    function startDrag(getX) {
      var rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      handle.classList.add('dragging');
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
      function move(ev) {
        var pct = Math.max(15, Math.min(85, ((getX(ev) - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100));
        left.style.flex = 'none';
        left.style.width = pct + '%';
        right.style.flex = 'none';
        right.style.width = (100 - pct) + '%';
        cm.refresh();
      }
      function stop() {
        handle.classList.remove('dragging');
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', move);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', stop);
        document.removeEventListener('touchmove', move);
        document.removeEventListener('touchend', stop);
      }
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', stop);
      document.addEventListener('touchmove', move, { passive: false });
      document.addEventListener('touchend', stop);
    }

    handle.addEventListener('mousedown', function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      startDrag(function (e) { return e.clientX; });
    });
    handle.addEventListener('touchstart', function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      startDrag(function (e) { return e.touches[0].clientX; });
    });

    el('mdp-vhandle').addEventListener('mousedown', function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      var startY = ev.clientY;
      var startH = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
      function move(e) {
        var h = Math.max(280, startH + (e.clientY - startY));
        wrapper.style.height = h + 'px';
        wrapper.style.minHeight = h + 'px';
        cm.refresh();
      }
      function stop() {
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', move);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', stop);
      }
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', stop);
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------- sync scroll
  function ratio(node) {
    var span = node.scrollHeight - node.clientHeight;
    return span > 0 ? node.scrollTop / span : 0;
  }

  function initSyncScroll() {
    previewScroll.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
      if (!el('mdp-sync').checked || syncing || viewMode !== 'split' || !cm) return;
      syncing = true;
      var info = cm.getScrollInfo();
      cm.scrollTo(null, ratio(previewScroll) * Math.max(0, info.height - info.clientHeight));
      setTimeout(function () { syncing = false; }, 40);
    });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ drag drop
  function initDrop() {
    var container = el('mdp-container');
    var overlay = el('mdp-drop');
    var depth = 0;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(function (type) {
      container.addEventListener(type, function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        if (type === 'dragenter') depth++;
        overlay.classList.add('visible');
      });
    });
    container.addEventListener('dragleave', function () {
      depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
      if (!depth) overlay.classList.remove('visible');
    });
    container.addEventListener('drop', function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      depth = 0;
      overlay.classList.remove('visible');
      if (ev.dataTransfer.files && ev.dataTransfer.files.length) loadFile(ev.dataTransfer.files[0]);
    });
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------- init
  function init() {
    var saved = '';
    var savedFmt = '';
    try {
      saved = localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY) || '';
      savedFmt = localStorage.getItem(STORE_FMT) || '';
    } catch (e) { /* storage blocked */ }

    format = savedFmt || 'markdown';
    var startText = saved || SAMPLE;
    if (!saved) { format = 'markdown'; fileName = 'sample.md'; }

    cm = CodeMirror(el('mdp-cm-wrap'), {
      value: startText,
      mode: cmMode(format),
      lineNumbers: true,
      lineWrapping: true,
      matchBrackets: true,
      autoCloseBrackets: true,
      styleActiveLine: true,
      tabSize: 2,
      indentWithTabs: false,
      extraKeys: {
        'Tab': function (editor) { editor.replaceSelection('  ', 'end'); },
        'Ctrl-Enter': render,
        'Cmd-Enter': render,
        'Ctrl-B': function () { insertAround('**|**'); },
        'Cmd-B': function () { insertAround('**|**'); },
        'Ctrl-I': function () { insertAround('*|*'); },
        'Cmd-I': function () { insertAround('*|*'); },
        'Ctrl-K': function () { insertAround('[|](https://)'); },
        'Cmd-K': function () { insertAround('[|](https://)'); }
      }
    });

    setFormat(format, true);

    cm.on('change', function () {
      clearTimeout(debounce);
      debounce = setTimeout(function () {
        render();
        updateStatus();
        checkDetection();
        save();
      }, 220);
    });

    cm.on('cursorActivity', function () {
      var c = cm.getCursor();
      el('mdp-cursor').textContent = 'Ln ' + (c.line + 1) + ', Col ' + (c.ch + 1);
    });

    cm.on('scroll', function () {
      if (!el('mdp-sync').checked || syncing || viewMode !== 'split') return;
      syncing = true;
      var info = cm.getScrollInfo();
      var span = Math.max(1, info.height - info.clientHeight);
      var span2 = previewScroll.scrollHeight - previewScroll.clientHeight;
      previewScroll.scrollTop = (info.top / span) * Math.max(0, span2);
      setTimeout(function () { syncing = false; }, 40);
    });

    el('mdp-format').addEventListener('change', function () { setFormat(this.value); });
    el('mdp-file').addEventListener('change', function () {
      if (this.files && this.files[0]) loadFile(this.files[0]);
      this.value = '';
    });
    el('mdp-theme').addEventListener('change', function () {
      previewScroll.className = 'mdp-preview-scroll theme-' + this.value;
    });
    el('mdp-width').addEventListener('change', function () {
      preview.classList.toggle('width-narrow', this.value === 'narrow');
      el('mdp-fullscreen-body').classList.toggle('width-narrow', this.value === 'narrow');
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
      if (ev.key === 'Escape' && el('mdp-fullscreen').classList.contains('active')) toggleFullscreen();
      if ((ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey) && ev.key === 's' && el('mdp-container').contains(document.activeElement)) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        actions['exp-source']();
      }
    });

    initResize();
    initSyncScroll();
    initDrop();
    render();
    updateStatus();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
````
